Bangladesh Cricket Chief Regrets T20 World Cup Venue Choice

Bangladesh Cricket Board (BCB) President Nazmul Hassan Papon stated that Bangladesh should have played the T20 World Cup in India, not the West Indies. He drew a parallel, saying Iran played in America during wartime. Papon also commented on Mustafizur Rahman's early removal from the IPL, stating the BCB had to intervene to protect the player for national duty. He indicated that a series between India and Bangladesh is not yet cancelled.
